Finance paused all procurement >$50k until Q3 planning. Security had open items but said they were 'non-blocking' vs finance. Competitor outreach: BigCloudAI offered turnkey managed endpoints with lower short-term cost; procurement asked for price comparison but then freeze happened.

- Routing/fallback: need canary & A/B rollouts, automatic fallback to lower-cost variants during peak.

Open items / blockers: short list — finance hold (primary), no replacement champion, hiring freeze prevents additional infra/ML hires, procurement unwilling to approve pilot spend. Security still wants formal KMS architecture diagram but said it could be resolved if project unpaused.

- Status: paused. No active timeline from customer. AE to add to watchlist; check back after Q2 planning cycle in late May.
- Action: send light-touch note in 6–8 weeks with updated ROI/TCO scenarios and a one-pager for low-cost pilot (edge/dedicated burst) — try to re-engage procurement when freeze lifted.

- "Finance has put all platform projects on hold until headcount approval; please don't send new contracts until Q3 planning." — Procurement lead (email).
